text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite being impressed by the<n>strength of the
other racers at the<n>Takarazuka Kinen, Mejiro Dober
remains focused on what she really<n>has to
defeat—her own weakness.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove, noticing a change in<n>Mejiro Dober,
looks forward to<n>seeing her performance.
